evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone search capability; no other backlog story is a prerequisite at the requirement level.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having a user profile available/defined; the backlog contains other profile-based features but no explicit story to create/manage profiles, making this story dependent on an unrepresented prerequisite capability.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Requires user profiles and similarity computation between users; this is a prerequisite capability not provided as a self-contained story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Can be delivered as a standalone content-similarity search given an input video; no explicit dependency on another story is inherent.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Requires videos to be segmented into segments; segmentation is explicitly covered by another story and is a prerequisite for segment thumbnails.

evaluations.evidence: perceptually similar video items and segments
